frame.noEndpoint: Not attached to any Endpoint yet

banner.title: This profile is locked
banner.text: You cannot change anything in it until you unlock it.

dialog.lockText: While it is locked nothing in the profile can change without this password. Reading and exporting stay open.
dialog.unlockText: Enter the lock password of this profile.
dialog.needText: This change takes a locked profile away from an Endpoint or a client. Enter the lock password of each of them.
dialog.needAnyText: This change may take a locked profile away from an Endpoint or a client. Fill in the lock passwords you know; a password the change does not need is ignored.
dialog.needMoreText: That was not enough: more locked profiles are involved. Fill in the passwords you know, and keep the ones you typed.
dialog.passwordHint: 6 to 128 characters. It belongs to this profile alone and is not your account password.
dialog.messageHint: Optional, up to 256 characters. Whoever opens the profile sees it.
dialog.wrong: The password of “{name}” is not right.

custom.name: Custom
custom.text: Starts empty. You put in whatever you need.

developer.name: Developer
developer.text: Cuts ads and trackers and stops malware.

gaming.name: Gaming
gaming.text: Blocks malware and phishing and stays out of the way of games.

kids.name: Kids
kids.text: Blocks adult content, gambling and dating, and turns on safe search.

privacy.name: Privacy
privacy.text: Blocks trackers and device telemetry strictly.

productivity.name: Focus
productivity.text: Blocks social networks, games and other distractions.

vpn_replacement.name: VPN replacement
vpn_replacement.text: Sends traffic through a fitting location automatically.

list.label: Profiles
list.emptyText: A profile is a set of filters, services and rules that an Endpoint uses.
list.searchEmptyText: Check the spelling or clear the search.
list.summary: {count, plural, one {# profile} other {# profiles}}, sorted by {sort}
list.endpointsAria: {count, plural, one {# Endpoint} other {# Endpoints}}, profile {name}

dialogs.flagged: {count, plural, one {# destination is not available yet and acts as Bypass.} other {# destinations are not available yet and act as Bypass.}}

import.title: Import profile
import.text: Choose the JSON file that Ctrl Z exported. It becomes a new profile, with no lock.
import.dropHint: JSON only, up to {max, number} MB.
import.tooLarge: The file is larger than 4 MB.
import.unreadable: The file could not be read. Choose it again.
import.more: There may be more problems after these. Fix these and import again.

duplicate.title: Duplicate profile {name}
duplicate.text: The copy has the same filters, services, rules and options as “{name}”, and no lock.
duplicate.name: Name of the copy
duplicate.iranianText: A rule or service redirects a name on the Iranian list. In the Rules and Services tabs, find the rows marked “acts as Bypass”, set each to Block or Bypass, then duplicate again. The pointers are positions in the exported file.
duplicate.iranianRules: Open the Rules of this profile
duplicate.iranianServices: Open the Services of this profile

delete.title: Delete profile {name}?
delete.text: The filters, services, rules and options of “{name}” are removed and cannot be brought back.
delete.inUseText: A profile cannot be deleted while an Endpoint or a schedule uses it. Move them to another profile first.
delete.lockedText: A locked profile cannot be deleted. Unlock it first (Options, Lock Profile), then delete it.

jobRunning.title: A large job is already running
jobRunning.text: This request was not started. Wait for that job to end, then try again.

filters.title: Filters

malware.body: Blocks domains known to spread malware or to control infected devices.

ads-trackers.body: Blocks the ads and trackers that follow what you do on sites and in apps. Relaxed, Balanced and Strict set how far it goes.

adult.body: Blocks adult sites. It has two modes: Relaxed and Strict.

clickbait.body: Blocks sites that collect visits with bait headlines and thin content.

crypto.body: Blocks cryptocurrency sites and services, miners included.

drugs.body: Blocks sites that present or sell illegal drugs.

dynamic-dns.body: Blocks dynamic DNS domains, which are sometimes used to hide a malware server.

file-hosting.body: Blocks file hosting and sharing services.

games.body: Blocks online game sites and services.

iot-telemetry.body: Blocks the automatic reports that smart home devices send to their makers.

new-domains.body: Blocks domains that were just registered, which are often used for scams and malware. It has two modes: last week and last month. Domains ending in .ir or .ایران are not covered by this filter, because their registration date is not published anywhere.

phishing.body: Blocks fake sites built to steal passwords and bank details.

url-shorteners.body: Blocks link shorteners, since they hide where a link really goes.

vpn-dns.body: Blocks VPN and alternative DNS services that can get around the profile's filters.

1hosts-lite.body: A light list with few mistakes, for ads and trackers.

1hosts-xtra.body: A wider list than Lite. It covers more and also blocks harmless sites more often.

adguard-dns.body: The official DNS filter list for ads and trackers.

hagezi-light.body: A light list for the fewest mistakes.

hagezi-normal.body: A balanced list for ads, trackers and malware.

hagezi-pro.body: A wider list with more coverage. Fits most advanced users.

hagezi-pro-plus.body: A stricter list than Pro. Harmless sites are blocked more often.

hagezi-tif.body: A threat list of malware, phishing and scam domains.

hagezi-ultimate.body: The strictest list of this family. Only for someone who accepts allowing sites by hand now and then.

oisd-basic.body: A small, careful list that almost never blocks a harmless site.

oisd-full.body: The full list, with more coverage than Basic.

stevenblack-unified.body: The well-known unified list for ads and malware.

filters.emptyText: The list of filters is empty for now. Try again in a moment.
filters.deprecatedNote: This filter is no longer updated. You can turn it off, but it cannot be turned on again.
filters.unavailableNote: The data of this filter is not ready yet.

relaxed.name: Relaxed
relaxed.text: The least blocking. A site is rarely closed by mistake.

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.text: Good coverage with few mistakes. Fits most profiles.

strict.name: Strict
strict.text: The most coverage. Sometimes a harmless site or app is blocked too.

last_week.name: Last week
last_week.text: Domains registered in the last 7 days.

last_month.name: Last month
last_month.text: Domains registered in the last 28 days.

newDomains.title: .ir and .ایران domains are not covered
newDomains.warning: Domains ending in .ir or .ایران are not covered by this filter, because their registration date is not published anywhere.

advanced.title: Advanced mode
advanced.text: Outside groups keep these lists, and they may block a harmless site too. If you are not sure, the native filters are enough.

many.title: More than one list is on
many.text: These lists overlap, and each list adds more mistaken blocks. If a site does not open for no reason, turn one off.
